status_as_of_cutoff: Local process / proposed. Utah government inventory and current Tract project pages identify Tract Pole Canyon and Tract Pony Express as proposed / owned and in development, with 1,700 MW and 120 MW respectively. Eagle Mountain records link a related Tract / UTLCO Eagle Mtn. Two 672-acre development-agreement and Triple Tail CRA geography to parcels/areas near Meta, Google, QTS, Firefly, Pole Canyon Blvd, and Pony Express Pkwy, but no building permit, site-work/construction start, interconnection approval, energization, commissioning, or live-service record was located. The exact overlap with USDC-0182 / Project Tripletail remains unresolved.
evidence_grade: B: official Utah public-notice/government inventory plus current owner project pages confirm proposed/development status, owner/developer, acreage, and MW; final parcel crosswalk and construction/energization evidence remain unverified.

actions.government_body: Eagle Mountain City Council / Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency
actions.action_type: related Tract development-agreement and Triple Tail CRA agenda packet
actions.result_status: The official city council notice and packet scheduled an ordinance approving the Tract Development Agreement for approximately 672 acres distributed among two parcels. The packet identifies Tract as applicant, UTLCO Eagle Mtn. Two, LLC as the agreement company, and describes the property as undeveloped land intended for large-scale projects that may include data centers and related power/fiber/security/cooling infrastructure. The same agenda describes the Triple Tail CRA as approximately 1,170.44 acres over 24 parcels, with north parcels south of 4000 North / north of Pole Canyon Blvd / east of Tyson Pkwy and a south parcel south of 1000 North / east of Pony Express Pkwy. This is retained as related land-process context, not proof of a building permit or construction.
actions.vote_tally: Official packet reviewed; direct signed minutes/vote record not retrieved in this refresh. Third-party CivicClerk-derived search index indicated a 5-0 yes vote, but the project record does not rely on that as primary evidence.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: Tract Development Agreement; Triple Tail Community Reinvestment Project Area Plan
actions.access_caveat: Official agenda/packet evidence; final executed agreement, recorded instrument, building permit, site plan, and utility service records were not located.
actions.evidence_note: Related to the same Tract Eagle Mountain land cluster; exact parcel-to-campus crosswalk to Pole Canyon/Pony Express is unresolved.

actions.result_status: Tract's current Pole Canyon project page lists the campus as Owned & In Development, 844 acres, 1,700 MW capacity, 18 parcels, industrial zoning, by-right data center use, and master-planned power/water/network infrastructure. Tract's current Pony Express page lists Owned & In Development, 225 acres, 120 MW capacity, within the Eagle Mountain RTI overlay, industrial zoning, by-right data center use, adjacency to 345 kV transmission, and four parcels.
actions.access_caveat: Company pages accessed 2026-08-11; no construction, energization, or tenant live-service evidence on these pages.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms owner/developer, named campuses, acres, and MW; stage wording remains below construction.

actions.result_status: Tract announced completion of more than 668 acres of land acquisition in Eagle Mountain within the RTI Overlay and said it was working with Rocky Mountain Power to deliver more than 400 MW via new transmission infrastructure by 2028. This supports land-control and power-planning context but is not a current interconnection approval or energized service record.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; 2028 power delivery is forward-looking.
actions.evidence_note: Retained as context for the Eagle Mountain Tract land cluster.
